plan.major: Teaching, Schools and Society: Teaching, Schools and Advocacy Concentration
plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-14 from the official Salem College 2026-2027 Undergraduate Catalog (current edition, catoid=34), Teaching, Schools and Society Major (BA) program page (poid=898), Teaching, Schools and Advocacy concentration. Salem College publishes major requirements but no official semester sequence for this program (its Print Degree Planner is a blank worksheet), so the plan is collected in requirements_only form as a single block. The full degree requirements, including the Salem Impact core (published separately in the same catalog), are not itemized here. Per-course credits are the Hour(s) values printed on each course's own official course detail page in the same catalog; the program page itself prints no per-course credits. Prerequisites naming courses outside this plan are disclosed in these notes and are not recorded as plan prerequisites. The introduction states that students select a concentration within the major; the two concentrations are collected as two plans sharing the printed 'Core Courses for all TSS Concentrations' block. The introduction also states that students can pursue a licensure curriculum of professional studies courses '(listed below the major itself)', but no such list appears on the program page, which ends after the Social Sciences concentration; nothing beyond the printed major blocks is collected. No heading on the page prints an hour subtotal and no total is printed; the recorded total is the exact itemized sum at the values stated in these notes. EDUC 112's title is truncated as printed ('Historic and Social Foundations of Educ') on both the program page and its course detail page. The recorded total (34) is the exact itemized sum: the shared core at 12, the four fixed concentration courses at 13 (PSYC 010 is printed at 4 Hour(s); the other three at 3), and the three choose slots at 3 each. Prerequisites recorded only where every named course is a fixed course in this plan: none of the fixed courses in this plan prints a prerequisite line; the choose-list courses' prerequisites are disclosed on the slots. HIST 221's title prints no apostrophe ('American Womens History'), as printed. SOCI 130's course detail page prints the self-referential line 'Cross-Listed with SOCI 130' [sic]; its cross-listing with NFPM 130 is printed on NFPM 130's detail page.

Teaching, Schools and Advocacy Elective
courses.choice_note: Choose one course from the printed 'Choose three from:' list, recorded at 3 Hour(s). The list prints twenty bullets; the nineteen printed at a fixed 3 Hour(s) are listed here. Disclosed, not listed: HIST 211 Public History is printed at 4 Hour(s) (a completion using it totals one hour more, as printed). Three listed bullets are the cross-listed partners of three others, as printed on their course detail pages: NFPM 130 and SOCI 130 (same title), NFPM 140 and ENTR 120 (same title), PSYC 130 and SOCI 205 (same title); each such pair is one course counted once. Disclosed prerequisites of the listed courses: PSYC 100, PSYC 130 and SOCI 205 each require PSYC 010 (a fixed course in this plan); HIST 211 requires one of HIST 103, HIST 104, HIST 105 or HIST 106 (none a course in this plan).
